site.en.title: GQB Tools – Free Online Tools
site.en.description: Free online calculators, converters, PDF, image, text and developer tools.

en:percentage-calculator.title: Percentage Calculator – Free Online
en:percentage-calculator.description: Calculate percentages, percentage change, and percent of a value with this free online calculator.
en:percentage-calculator.intro: Enter a value and a percentage to calculate the result quickly.

en:age-calculator.title: Age Calculator – Calculate Your Age Online
en:age-calculator.description: Calculate your age from a birth date with a fast, free online age calculator.
en:age-calculator.intro: Enter a birth date to calculate age in years.

en:currency-converter.title: Currency Converter – Live Exchange Rates
en:currency-converter.description: Convert currencies online using current public exchange-rate data. Compare common currencies quickly.
en:currency-converter.intro: Enter an amount, choose the currencies, and convert using the latest available public rate.

en:unit-converter.title: Unit Converter – Free Online Conversions
en:unit-converter.description: Convert common length, data, speed, area, volume and weight units online.
en:unit-converter.intro: Choose the source and target units, enter a value, and convert instantly.

en:password-generator.title: Password Generator – Secure Random Passwords
en:password-generator.description: Generate a random password in your browser with adjustable length and symbols.
en:password-generator.intro: Choose a password length and symbol option, then generate a random password.

en:word-counter.title: Word Counter – Count Words & Characters
en:word-counter.description: Count words, characters, CJK characters and estimated reading time online.
en:word-counter.intro: Paste or type text to see word and character counts instantly.

en:qr-code-generator.title: QR Code Generator – Free Online QR Codes
en:qr-code-generator.description: Create a QR code from text or a URL directly in your browser.
en:qr-code-generator.intro: Enter a URL or text and generate a QR code for quick sharing.

en:image-resizer.title: Image Resizer – Resize Images Online
en:image-resizer.description: Resize images in your browser by setting width, height and output quality.
en:image-resizer.intro: Choose an image, set the target dimensions and download the resized file.

en:image-compressor.title: Image Compressor – Compress Images Online
en:image-compressor.description: Compress an image in your browser and download a smaller JPG file.
en:image-compressor.intro: Choose an image, adjust quality, and download the compressed result.

en:jpg-to-pdf.title: JPG to PDF – Convert Images to PDF
en:jpg-to-pdf.description: Turn one or more images into a PDF directly in your browser.
en:jpg-to-pdf.intro: Select images and create a PDF file with one image per page.

en:heic-to-jpg.title: HEIC to JPG – Free Online Converter
en:heic-to-jpg.description: Convert HEIC images to JPG directly in your browser. Choose a HEIC file and download a JPG copy.
en:heic-to-jpg.intro: Choose a HEIC or HEIF image and convert it to JPG in your browser.

en:pdf-to-text.title: PDF to Text – Extract Text Online
en:pdf-to-text.description: Extract selectable text from a PDF in your browser. Download or copy the extracted text.
en:pdf-to-text.intro: Choose a PDF to extract its text directly in your browser.

en:date-add-subtract.title: Date Add / Subtract Calculator – Free Online
en:date-add-subtract.description: Add or subtract a number of days from a date with this free online date calculator.
en:date-add-subtract.intro: Choose a date, enter the number of days, and add or subtract them.

en:image-to-text.title: Image to Text OCR – Extract Text from Images
en:image-to-text.description: Extract text from an image with browser-based OCR. Choose a language, recognize the image, and copy the resulting text.
en:image-to-text.intro: Upload an image, choose the recognition language, and extract text in your browser.

en:pdf-to-jpg.title: PDF to JPG – Convert PDF Pages to Images
en:pdf-to-jpg.description: Convert PDF pages to JPG images in your browser. Generate a JPG for each page and download the results.
en:pdf-to-jpg.intro: Choose a PDF to render its pages as JPG images directly in your browser.

en:delete-pdf-pages.title: Delete PDF Pages – Remove Pages Online
en:delete-pdf-pages.description: Remove selected pages from a PDF in your browser and create a new PDF without those pages.
en:delete-pdf-pages.intro: Upload a PDF, enter the pages to remove, and create a new PDF.

en:rotate-pdf.title: Rotate PDF – Rotate Pages Online
en:rotate-pdf.description: Rotate every page of a PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees and download the result in your browser.
en:rotate-pdf.intro: Choose a PDF, select a rotation angle, and create a rotated copy.

en:pdf-page-numbers.title: Add PDF Page Numbers – Number Pages Online
en:pdf-page-numbers.description: Add sequential page numbers to a PDF in your browser and download the numbered document.
en:pdf-page-numbers.intro: Choose a PDF and a starting number to add page numbers to every page.

en:pdf-watermark.title: Add PDF Watermark – Watermark a PDF Online
en:pdf-watermark.description: Add a text watermark to every PDF page directly in your browser and download the watermarked file.
en:pdf-watermark.intro: Choose a PDF, enter watermark text, and create a watermarked copy.

en:pdf-to-png.title: PDF to PNG – Convert PDF Pages to PNG
en:pdf-to-png.description: Convert PDF pages to PNG images directly in your browser. Create a PNG image for each PDF page.
en:pdf-to-png.intro: Choose a PDF to render each page as a PNG image in your browser.

en:pdf-ocr.title: PDF OCR – Extract Text from Scanned PDFs
en:pdf-ocr.description: Run OCR on selected PDF pages in your browser to extract text from scanned documents. Choose a language and page range.
en:pdf-ocr.intro: Choose a scanned PDF, select the recognition language and up to five pages, then extract text in your browser.

en:business-days-calculator.title: Business Days Calculator – Count Workdays
en:business-days-calculator.description: Count weekdays between two dates with this free business days calculator. Weekends are excluded from the result.
en:business-days-calculator.intro: Choose a start and end date to count the weekdays between them.

en:percentage-change-calculator.title: Percentage Change Calculator – Calculate Increase or Decrease
en:percentage-change-calculator.description: Calculate percentage increase or decrease between an old value and a new value with this free online calculator.
en:percentage-change-calculator.intro: Enter the old and new values to calculate the percentage increase or decrease.

en:roi-calculator.title: ROI Calculator – Return on Investment
en:roi-calculator.description: Calculate return on investment from cost and return values with a free online ROI calculator.
en:roi-calculator.intro: Enter the investment cost and value received to calculate ROI.

en:markup-calculator.title: Markup Calculator – Calculate Markup Percentage
en:markup-calculator.description: Calculate markup percentage and profit from cost and selling price with this free online markup calculator.
en:markup-calculator.intro: Enter cost and selling price to calculate markup percentage and profit.

en:break-even-calculator.title: Break-Even Calculator – Calculate Break-Even Point
en:break-even-calculator.description: Calculate the units and revenue needed to cover fixed and variable costs with a free break-even calculator.
en:break-even-calculator.intro: Enter fixed costs, selling price per unit and variable cost per unit to calculate break-even units.

en:extract-pdf-pages.title: Extract PDF Pages – Create a New PDF from Selected Pages
en:extract-pdf-pages.description: Extract selected pages from a PDF and create a new PDF directly in your browser.
en:extract-pdf-pages.intro: Enter the page numbers or ranges to extract them into a new PDF.

en:reorder-pdf-pages.title: Reorder PDF Pages – Rearrange PDF Pages Online
en:reorder-pdf-pages.description: Rearrange PDF pages by entering a new page order and create a reordered PDF in your browser.
en:reorder-pdf-pages.intro: Enter the new page order, such as 3,1,2,4-5, to create a reordered PDF.

en:bmi-calculator.title: BMI Calculator – Adult BMI, Reference Ranges & Results
en:bmi-calculator.description: Free BMI calculator for adults. Enter height and weight to see BMI, reference categories, a height-based weight range and optional waist-to-height context.
en:bmi-calculator.intro: Enter your height and weight to calculate adult BMI, compare reference ranges, and see what the number does and does not tell you.

zh:bmi-calculator.title: BMI 计算器 – 成人 BMI 与参考范围
zh:bmi-calculator.description: 免费 BMI 计算器。输入身高和体重，查看成人 BMI、不同参考标准、参考体重范围，以及可选的腰围与腰高比信息。
zh:bmi-calculator.intro: 输入身高和体重，查看成人 BMI、参考分类、体重范围，以及下一步可以关注的指标。
